rho_reference.protocol: rho.signed_frobenius_strong (arm rho-strong, role reference), as named by PROTOCOL.md; uses all 2n automorphisms (negation x Frobenius): automorphisms_used 34 / 38 / 46 / 58 at n = 17 / 19 / 23 / 29 in every record
rho_reference.unit: counted GAE (ecbench.gae), S = GAE / sqrt(r); sqrt(r) = 2048.6344 at n = 23 and 206.0510 at n = 29
rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench sha256 a0be1b2a3a02f5385c9b9654622b01923f3f54a52904bd157861e0cbe8796d29 (embedded git_commit 21f66351); rho and both IC arms ran in the same ecbench session of every job (one RunPod CPU pod, L0)
rho_reference.gae_band_cell: n = 23 (icv1-f2m23-tm5197-1f85e9e1), pooled over the 8 targets (n23-j0 t0..t3, n23-j1 t0..t3), ic = ic-pt-l9 (the l* arm), mean S per measured solve (40 solves per arm, all verified)
rho_reference.gae_band_definition: AGENTS.md section 5a full band: every *_uncharged rho counter and every native IC operation (relation trials, relation lookups, AS solves, Frobenius maps, LA row ops, solver ops) charged at w GAE; equal to `ecbench band` for every arm; bitop/v1 reported as a calibration-free cross-check
rho_reference.order_note: rho-strong is cheaper than every IC arm at w = 0, 0.1, 1 and in bitop at every n (l* gap 2.67 to 9.86 bits; CI lower ends all above 2.6). Within IC, l* is cheaper than pt-l7 at n = 23 and 29 at every weight and in bitop (R CI lower ends 1.265 / 1.229 / 1.077 and 0.669 / 0.722 / 0.979). `ecbench band --ranks` agrees. Index calculus does not beat rho anywhere in the band. The gap is the distance remaining to matched rho, not a pass/fail gate.
rho_reference.caveats: D = (R_n23 + 7 R_n29) / 84 identically (l* = 7 at n = 17, 19); the 23 -> 29 segment of D is negative at w = 0 and 0.1. n is the field degree; log2 r = 16.0, 18.0, 22.0, 15.4, so slopes over n describe these four curves only. Cross-target vs validated ic-ridge at n = 23: ridge - l9 gap 1.53 [1.30, 1.73] (w = 0), 13.20 (w = 0.1), 15.59 (w = 1) bits.
